name: keyboard-decided-call-order
description: The page opens the menu modal, and the host holds its answer; the decided keyboard call of a surface goes out while that answer is held and the host holds its answer too, and an ordered keyboard call to another surface goes out only after both answers.
reason: overlayShow opens a native modal view and surfaceFocus gives the keyboard of the window to a surface, and only the native host with a window produces their answers (the native tier of docs/operations/examples.md#test-kinds).
